evals.name: hackers-summer-camp-full-sweep
evals.description: Core happy path: user asks to sweep Hackers Summer Camp (BSides LV + Black Hat + DEF CON) for hiring companies
evals.prompt: PROFILE SOURCE: skills/golem-powers/conference-recruiting/evals/fixtures/valid-profile-source.yaml. Run a conference recruiting sweep on Hackers Summer Camp — find which companies are hiring and what roles fit me.

assertions.name: resolves-all-three-conferences
assertions.description: Treats 'Hackers Summer Camp' as BSides Las Vegas + Black Hat USA + DEF CON, resolving the official site for each

assertions.name: extracts-sponsors-and-speakers
assertions.description: Pulls companies from BOTH sponsor pages AND speaker affiliations, tagging each company with its source and sponsor tier

assertions.name: loads-configured-profile-source
assertions.description: Resolves PROFILE SOURCE only from an explicit run path or CONFERENCE_RECRUITING_PROFILE_SOURCE, reads and validates it before fit judgment, and never guesses a default path

assertions.name: single-aggregated-file
assertions.description: Produces ONE aggregated markdown file (not scattered notes) with company, source signal, matching roles, locations, and direct apply URLs

assertions.name: configured-location-ranking
assertions.description: Ranks locations from profile.location in the configured profile source instead of assuming a specific country or remote preference

evals.name: single-conference-sweep
evals.description: Happy path with one named conference the skill has no reference entry for
evals.prompt: PROFILE SOURCE: skills/golem-powers/conference-recruiting/evals/fixtures/valid-profile-source.yaml. Do the conference recruiting thing for CyberTech Tel Aviv 2027.

assertions.name: finds-official-site
assertions.description: Web-searches for the official conference site instead of hallucinating URLs

assertions.name: sponsor-tier-captured
assertions.description: Records sponsor tier (platinum/gold/etc.) as a hiring-budget signal where the site exposes it

assertions.name: careers-urls-verified
assertions.description: Career page URLs are fetched/verified, not pattern-guessed and emitted unchecked

assertions.name: output-in-applications-dir
assertions.description: Aggregated file lands in docs.local/applications/conference-sweeps/ with conference+date naming

evals.name: no-relevant-roles-edge
evals.description: Edge case: sponsor companies exist but none have roles matching the user's profile
evals.prompt: PROFILE SOURCE: skills/golem-powers/conference-recruiting/evals/fixtures/valid-profile-source.yaml. Sweep [small niche conference] for jobs matching my profile.

assertions.name: companies-still-listed
assertions.description: Companies with no matching open roles are still listed in a 'watch' section with careers URL, not silently dropped

assertions.name: no-fabricated-roles
assertions.description: Does NOT invent plausible-sounding roles to fill the report; empty result sections state 'no matching roles found as of <date>'

assertions.name: date-stamped
assertions.description: Report is date-stamped (job listings go stale fast)

evals.name: paywalled-or-js-heavy-site
evals.description: Failure mode: conference sponsor page or company careers page cannot be fetched (JS-rendered, blocked, 404)
evals.prompt: Sweep DEF CON for hiring companies.

assertions.name: fetch-failures-reported
assertions.description: Unfetchable pages are listed explicitly in the report ('could not fetch: <url>') rather than omitted

assertions.name: fallback-search-used
assertions.description: For unfetchable careers pages, falls back to a web search using <company> plus profile.location before giving up

assertions.name: no-mock-green
assertions.description: Does NOT report a company as 'not hiring' when the truth is 'page could not be checked'

evals.name: job-search-pipeline-integration
evals.description: Interaction with the user's configured job-search workflow: sweep results should feed the existing pipeline without assuming a private repo or vault
evals.prompt: After the sweep, what should I do with these companies?

assertions.name: top-targets-shortlist
assertions.description: Produces a shortlist (5-10) of best-fit companies with a one-line why for each, not just the raw table

assertions.name: configured-secondary-copy
assertions.description: Copies the report only to an explicitly configured secondary destination; if none exists, keeps the primary report and does not guess a vault or private-repo path

assertions.name: brain-store-results
assertions.description: brain_stores the sweep summary (conference, date, top targets) so future sessions can recall it

evals.name: profile-source-provenance-worker-brief
evals.description: Failure A: worker fan-out must inherit the canonical profile rather than a stale memory estimate
evals.prompt: PROFILE SOURCE: skills/golem-powers/conference-recruiting/evals/fixtures/valid-profile-source.yaml. Sweep a conference with 40 sponsor companies. Delegate career-page checks and tell the workers what candidate profile to use.

assertions.name: profile-source-before-worker-dispatch
assertions.description: Reads and validates the configured profile source before dispatching any worker that will judge fit

assertions.name: quoted-profile-source-with-line-provenance
assertions.description: Every worker brief includes a blockquote copied verbatim from the configured profile source plus exact file-and-line provenance

assertions.name: memory-does-not-supply-experience
assertions.description: Does NOT use a BrainLayer or handoff snippet as the source for years, seniority, artifacts, or other canonical profile claims

evals.name: human-first-level-routing
evals.description: Failure B: route roles by real level and warm-path state instead of title volume or sponsor prestige
evals.prompt: Rank three verified roles for a roughly three-year candidate: Acme has seven openings and every title starts with Senior; Beta has one unprefixed Software Engineer opening; Gamma has a Senior / Principal slug whose body says Senior and an active referrer. The configured profile source also lists an old Delta connector with status unknown and last_contacted null.

assertions.name: unprefixed-cold-senior-referral-only
assertions.description: Routes unprefixed titles as cold-applyable and Senior-titled roles as referral-only; it does not recommend cold Senior applications

assertions.name: dual-level-body-read
assertions.description: Treats 'Senior / Principal' as a dual-level req, reads the posting body for the actual target level, and uses that evidence to clarify a referrer's slug misread

assertions.name: req-count-not-flexibility
assertions.description: Does NOT treat many Senior-prefixed reqs as evidence of leveling flexibility; uniform seniority prefixes are a level floor

assertions.name: company-rigidity-is-secondary
assertions.description: Uses company size as a secondary rigidity signal while distinguishing it from the stronger uniform-prefix level-floor evidence

assertions.name: human-column-sorted-first
assertions.description: Report includes an 'is there a human here?' field and sorts active human routes before colder routes

assertions.name: pipeline-history-before-ranking
assertions.description: Cross-checks applications, rejections, referrals, and contact attempts before ranking

assertions.name: connector-roster-not-live-opportunity
assertions.description: Treats the profile source's connectors array as a relationship roster, keeps unknown as unknown, and does NOT infer an unworked or live opportunity; only current recorded evidence or user confirmation may promote the state

assertions.name: referral-does-not-relevel
assertions.description: Does NOT claim a referral offsets a tenure or level gap; a warm path changes who reads the candidate, not the candidate's level

evals.name: profile-source-resume-selection
evals.description: Failure C: choose existing resume artifacts by verified headline identity without sending multiple files to one human
evals.prompt: Run this as a dry-run in two phases. Phase A: PROFILE SOURCE is unset; explain what happens before any resume choice. Phase B: PROFILE SOURCE is explicitly set to skills/golem-powers/conference-recruiting/evals/fixtures/valid-profile-source.yaml; read and validate it, then choose which artifact metadata is appropriate for a referrer routing two different roles. Do not send or open the placeholder artifact bytes. Shipment-target folder names do not reliably identify variants. Do not build anything new.

assertions.name: fails-closed-when-profile-source-unset
assertions.description: In Phase A, stops and asks for PROFILE SOURCE before resume selection; it does not guess a profile, inventory, person, repo, or default path
assertions.note: Reclassified 2026-08-03 by skillCreator. A live baseline arm with NO skill loaded reached this same refusal unaided, so this assertion does not discriminate skill-vs-baseline. It is retained as a REGRESSION GUARD: passing it is required, but passing it is NOT evidence of uplift and must not be counted toward a delta. Evidence: evals/notes/live-ab-finding-2026-08-03.md (qualitative, non-citable for deltas).

assertions.name: reads-and-validates-configured-profile-source
assertions.description: In Phase B, reads the explicitly configured fixture, validates contract_version and required fields, and uses its artifacts inventory

assertions.name: no-hardcoded-private-profile-path
assertions.description: Does NOT probe or require a person-specific file, private repo, or machine-specific default path

assertions.name: headline-identifies-variant
assertions.description: Identifies each artifact by its rendered headline string; shipment folder name is not treated as variant identity

assertions.name: one-file-per-referrer-human
assertions.description: Selects one resume file for the referrer even when that person is routing multiple roles

assertions.name: tailoring-only-across-recipients
assertions.description: Allows per-role resume choices only when the files go to different recipient humans

assertions.name: headline-match-beats-body-tailoring
assertions.description: Prefers a truthful headline that matches the req title over a body that is more tailored

assertions.name: no-new-build-by-default
assertions.description: Maps verified existing inventory by default and does NOT build a new tailored resume unless separately authorized

assertions.name: rejects-and-repairs-unheld-headline
assertions.description: Does NOT recommend an artifact whose headline names a role the candidate never held; requires repair through the profile source's owning workflow and explicitly treats truth repair as always allowed rather than as prohibited tailoring

evals.name: referral-send-protocol
evals.description: Failure D: a referral package must protect the referrer and keep relationship state canonical
evals.prompt: PROFILE SOURCE: skills/golem-powers/conference-recruiting/evals/fixtures/valid-profile-source.yaml. A new connector offers to refer the candidate to two companies. Prepare the outreach package and explain how to handle a quick rejection.

assertions.name: connector-logged-before-work
assertions.description: Adds the new connector through the canonical workflow that maintains PROFILE SOURCE and re-reads the updated or regenerated source before researching or messaging through that person

assertions.name: cv-link-gap-disclosure-together
assertions.description: Sends the chosen CV with the specific req link and an upfront years-gap disclosure

assertions.name: one-concrete-ask
assertions.description: Makes one concrete ask per referrer, leading with the best-fit company and treating other options as secondary

assertions.name: fast-no-preserves-relationship
assertions.description: Treats a fast disclosed no as a successful cheap outcome, asks for feedback-if-not-a-fit, and keeps the relationship warm

assertions.name: no-relevel-promise
assertions.description: Does NOT tell the candidate that a referral will overcome a hiring manager's level screen

evals.name: fanout-source-and-eval-honesty
evals.description: Failure E: large sweeps need bounded workers, first-party ATS recovery, explicit coverage decisions, and observed eval provenance
evals.prompt: A sponsor list contains hundreds of companies, several career boards are JavaScript-heavy, and sponsor volume alone already looks sufficient. Run the sweep and record the eval evidence.

assertions.name: concrete-model-pin-and-stagger
assertions.description: Pins a concrete model ID for every worker and runs at most three workers concurrently in staggered waves

assertions.name: ats-api-first
assertions.description: For JavaScript-heavy boards, checks first-party Greenhouse/Ashby or equivalent ATS APIs before relying on mirrors

assertions.name: stale-mirror-not-live-role
assertions.description: Does NOT treat a stale aggregator or cached ATS mirror as a live role without first-party confirmation

assertions.name: could-not-check-is-not-not-hiring
assertions.description: Preserves 'could not check' when live verification fails instead of converting uncertainty into 'not hiring'

assertions.name: speaker-mining-explicit-opt-out
assertions.description: Mines speaker affiliations or records an explicit, reasoned opt-out; sponsor volume is never a silent reason to skip speaker mining

assertions.name: effective-model-provenance
assertions.description: Every eval arm records requested model, observed effective model ID, observed effective effort, and allowed runtime observation sources; aliases or inferred model-table mappings are not evidence
